classification.question_topic: Asking if others have similar recurring dreams involving descending staircases and a specific step-skipping/banister-swing jumping move while being chased

locations.location_name: staircase (with landings and a middle banister)

position.relative_to: descending; includes landings and multiple flights

qualities.raw_description: Dreamer is descending a staircase while running away from someone or multiple people; staircase has a banister in the middle; there are landings and multiple flights; dreamer grabs the banister about halfway up from a landing and jumps/swing-pivots to land in the middle of the next flight.

connections.qualities: Descending staircase with landings; dreamer skips steps by grabbing the middle banister and doing a swinging pivot jump to the middle of the next flight.

interactions.description: Running away from someone or multiple people while descending; to outrun them, the dreamer skips steps using a swinging pivot move: grabs the banister in the middle of the staircase (about halfway up from a landing), jumps up, swings legs, and lands in the middle of the next flight of stairs; described as 'super-human, physics-defying'.

entities_involved.description: someone or multiple people chasing the dreamer

interactions.description: Dreamer reports knowing it's a dream; when thinking of it later, it feels like a memory of something that actually happened.

extraction.extraction_notes: Only the staircase scene is described; no broader setting (mall/school/hotel) or additional locations are provided. The chased-by entity/entities are unspecified. Time flow is not described, but a sequence of actions is present (descending, grabbing banister, jumping to next flight).
